question: What visualization upon the attracted being's head empowers the practice further?
premises: The practitioner focuses on the head of the attracted being.
A seed-syllable is to be remembered there.
The seed-syllable is visualized as raining flowing nectar.
inference: One should visualize the seed-syllable on her head as showering flowing nectar.
plain_english: One should remember the seed-syllable on her head as raining streams of flowing nectar.
